mapper.insert: INSERT INTO charge_requests (id, tenant_id, user_id, username, amount, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{amount}, #{status}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM charge_requests WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM charge_requests WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge_requests WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE charge_requests SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
